site.title: Mohil Kumar
site.description: Portfolio of Mohil Kumar, a full stack developer building fast, accessible web products.
hero.title: I build web products that stay fast under load.
hero.body: Full stack developer working across TypeScript, Astro and Postgres. I care about the parts users feel: first paint, keyboard access, and pages that still work when the network does not.
about.title: About
about.body1: I have spent the last few years shipping production web applications end to end, from schema design through to the deploy pipeline. Most of that work has been in small teams where the person writing the query is also the person answering for the page load time.
about.body2: Outside of client work I write about performance budgets, build small tools I end up using every week, and keep a standing rule that nothing ships without a keyboard pass.
